help.heading: How can we help you today?

doctor.quote: I never want a patient to feel rushed, judged, or unsure of what happens next.
doctor.attribution: Dr. Noor — founder, Noor Dental Studio

treatment.heading: A smile you can see coming.
treatment.body: Straighten your smile with a plan built around your life, not the other way around.

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.desc: We start with an honest conversation about what you want and whether Invisalign is the right fit.

scan.title: Digital scan
scan.desc: A quick, comfortable 3D scan replaces old-fashioned molds entirely.

plan.title: Personalised plan
plan.desc: You see your projected result before committing to anything.

align.title: Align
align.desc: Wear your aligners as your smile shifts gradually into place.

reveal.title: Reveal
reveal.desc: Your new smile, exactly as planned.

arrive.title: Arrive
arrive.desc: Take your time. There's no rush the moment you walk in — settle in, breathe, and let us know you're here.

meet.title: Meet
meet.desc: You'll meet your care team first, not a chair. A quick, friendly hello before anything clinical happens.

talk.title: Talk
talk.desc: We ask about your concerns and history before we ask you to open your mouth. Nothing starts until you're ready.

examine.title: Examine
examine.desc: A gentle, unhurried look — we explain what we're checking and why as we go, step by step.

understand.title: Understand
understand.desc: We walk through what we found in plain language, with time for your questions.

decide.title: Decide
decide.desc: Any next steps are entirely your call. No pressure, no same-day upsell.

step3.notesLabel: Anything we should know before your visit? (optional)
step3.phoneError: Please enter a valid phone number.
step3.emailError: Please enter a valid email address.

confirmation.heading: You're booked.
confirmation.body: We'll send you everything you need before your visit.
